active_ingredient: Active ingredient (per tablet) Calcium Carbonate USP 750mg
indications_and_usage: Uses relieves heartburn sour stomach acid indigestion upset stomach associated with these symptoms
warnings: Warnings Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs. When using this product do not take more than 10 tablets in 24 hours if pregnant do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks except under the advice and supervision of a doctor Keep out of reach of children.
ask_doctor_or_pharmacist: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
when_using: When using this product do not take more than 10 tablets in 24 hours if pregnant do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks except under the advice and supervision of a doctor
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children.
dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 12 years of age and over: chew 2-4 tablets as symptoms occur, or as directed by a doctor. Do not swallow tablets whole. do not take for symptoms that persist for more than 2 weeks unless advised by a doctor
storage_and_handling: Other information each tablet contains: calcium 300mg store at room temperature. Keep the container tightly closed DO NOT USE IF PRINTED SEAL UNDER CAP IS TORN OR MISSING
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients D&C Yellow No. 10, dextrose, FD&C Blue No. 1, flavor, magnesium stearate, maltodextrin, starch, sucralose
